# 小型测试样例

按 `<event_id>/` 存放可以合法提交的小型 fixture。真实灾区大影像不进入本目录。
# Fixtures

Fixtures are small, reproducible examples used by tests. Real or unlicensed
remote-sensing data, model weights, and run outputs must not be committed.

`stage1_synthetic/` contains tiny synthetic GeoTIFF/GeoJSON inputs for the C3
offline map. It is marked synthetic in its manifest and must not be presented
as a real flood assessment or model result.
